intent_0000380ydn6r99ja8cyhpttebc.statement: Codex users discover and invoke the product as plugin tene with concise phase skills such as \u0024tene:plan while the repository remains named tene-codex
intent_0000380ydn6r99ja8cyhpttebc.rationale: The product identity is tene and repository/provider naming must not leak into the user-facing skill namespace
policies: skill names are concise phase names
old namespace must not remain discoverable
data_invariants: source staged and installed metadata agree
project workflow state survives plugin update and uninstall
constraints: Codex host discovery is validated as a black box
new version and fresh conversation are required
assumptions: qualified short skill names avoid ambiguity

intent_0000380ydn7ppsehvfk2qq2n2r.statement: The staged and locally installed tene plugin executes the bundled tene-workflow CLI and all skill handoffs with behavior identical to the source checkout
intent_0000380ydn7ppsehvfk2qq2n2r.rationale: Source-only tests do not prove the installed product actually works
policies: project state is never removed by uninstall
business_rules: source staged and installed contracts must match
data_invariants: installed bundle contains nine skills and executable launcher
workflow state remains valid across lifecycle
constraints: host UI selector is external black-box evidence
assumptions: local marketplace and Codex CLI are available
open_questions: host restart mechanism available to automated QA

intent_0000380yeckc0mm5dsr9j59h6m.statement: Active Sprint Stop hooks return valid Codex Stop-event JSON and never surface an invalid output failure
intent_0000380yeckc0mm5dsr9j59h6m.rationale: Advisory workflow status must not break the host turn lifecycle
desired_outcomes: active sprint warning remains visible without unintended continuation
non_goals: force every active Sprint turn to continue indefinitely
policies: event-specific official Codex hook schema is authoritative
advisory hook exits successfully with valid JSON
business_rules: Stop output uses common Stop fields rather than hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext
data_invariants: hook does not mutate workflow state
constraints: Codex hook contract can change and needs compatibility tests
assumptions: current local manual matches installed Codex behavior

intent_0000380yecmcwb7v4ttjm9bbrm.statement: tene writes authored Sprint documents in the language currently used by the user unless the user explicitly requests another language
intent_0000380yecmcwb7v4ttjm9bbrm.rationale: Workflow documents are user-facing collaboration artifacts and should remain linguistically consistent with the conversation
desired_outcomes: Korean conversation produces Korean authored documents
non_goals: translate code symbols or required machine markers
policies: current user language is the default document language
machine-readable IDs and markers remain stable
business_rules: skills preserve conversation language across PRD Plan Design Analysis QA and Report
data_invariants: document language preference is carried in context without changing schema markers
constraints: mixed-language technical terms and identifiers may remain original
assumptions: dominant language can be inferred from the current user request
